nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives HubSpot webhooks (several events per call are all read). Only COMPANY, CONTACT and SITE records that are not in Simpro yet are acted on; deal events (quotes and jobs) are ignored. ⚠ No auth in n8n (known open finding, left as is).

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: All settings in plain words (TEST MODE is switched here) + the records named in the webhook. Deals, deletions and unknown events end here.

nodes.name: Build Record Reads
nodes.notes: One batch read per record type (100 per call) with every property needed for Simpro.

nodes.name: Read Records
nodes.notes: Batch read of the records from HubSpot.

nodes.name: Prepare Records
nodes.notes: Create only: records already in Simpro are left alone. TEST MODE: only test records. Nothing left = the run ends here.

nodes.name: Build Association Reads
nodes.notes: Contacts need their company, sites their companies and contacts. One batch read per link type. Companies need none.

nodes.name: Any Associations To Read?
nodes.notes: True: read them. False: only companies, nothing to link.

nodes.name: Read Associations
nodes.notes: Batch read of the associations (100 records per call).

nodes.name: Build Related Reads
nodes.notes: Reads the Simpro ID of every related company and contact (batches of 100).

nodes.name: Any Related Records?
nodes.notes: True: read them. False: no related records at all.

nodes.name: Read Related Objects
nodes.notes: Batch read: the Simpro ID of each related record.

nodes.name: Resolve Plan
nodes.notes: Per record: where to create it in Simpro, the body, and the Simpro IDs it links to. A contact whose company is not in Simpro yet is skipped and reported.

nodes.name: Build Record Writes
nodes.notes: Create each planned record in Simpro (POST). Real Time never updates.

nodes.name: Any Records To Create?
nodes.notes: True: something to create. False: nothing is ready.

nodes.name: Write Records to Simpro
nodes.notes: Creates the records in Simpro, throttled to 5 per second. No automatic retry: a create must never run twice.

nodes.name: Build ID Write-Back
nodes.notes: Saves the new Simpro IDs on the HubSpot records right away (batch update per type), so a repeated webhook cannot create them twice.

nodes.name: Any IDs To Save?
nodes.notes: True: new Simpro IDs to save. False: nothing was created.

nodes.name: Write IDs to HubSpot
nodes.notes: Batch update of the Simpro ID property.

nodes.name: Build Site Links
nodes.notes: New sites: link to customers already in Simpro and set a primary contact.

nodes.name: Any Site Links?
nodes.notes: True: links to set. False: no sites or nothing to link.

nodes.name: Write Site Links
nodes.notes: Site links in Simpro (PATCH).

nodes.name: Report Result
nodes.notes: Fails the run if any call failed (error workflow); otherwise returns a summary of what was created and skipped.

parameters.content:
## [SPL] HubSpot -> Simpro (Real Time): create only (companies, contacts, sites)
Self-contained: no sub-workflows. The webhook is the only trigger.

1. Read the records named in the webhook (all events, batched). Deals (quotes and jobs) are ignored: they are created in Simpro, not HubSpot.
2. Already has a Simpro ID = leave alone (the 30-minute sync updates it).
3. **TEST MODE is ON** (Workflow Config: `testOnly: true`): only records whose name starts with `HSTEST-`, or whose own email domain is `aniccadigital.io` / `spl.com.au`, are created. Set it to `false` to create everything.
4. Create it in Simpro, save the new Simpro ID on the HubSpot record straight away, then link sites to customers that are already in Simpro. A contact whose company is not in Simpro yet is skipped and reported (nothing is created half-linked).

**After import (manual steps)**
- Connect `SPL Simpro` and `SPL Account` on every credentialed node and confirm no 'not connected' warning remains.
- Set Settings > Error Workflow.
- Import into the EXISTING workflow (select all, delete, import) so the `simpro-upsert` webhook URL stays valid for HubSpot.
- Optional: remove the deal subscriptions from the HubSpot app, they are ignored here.

⚠ The webhook has no authentication in n8n (known open finding).
